about: Steven F. Molo attended law school and graduated from University of Illinois College of Law in 1982. Steven Molo began practicing law in 1982.
Steven Molo is an attorney at MoloLamken LLP, helping people with Business Litigation issues. MoloLamken LLP has an office in Chicago, Illinois, serving the local community.

Steven Molo was selected to Super Lawyers for 2012 - 2013, 2020 - 2027. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
